options.content: **All runs** includes legacy and unsaved runs and deliberately ignores session filters. **Session runs** requires an exported session ID; names are opt-in. **Benchmark runs** alone applies Comparison ID / Task / Replicate ID resource filters, independently of session filters; `.*` includes missing fields. These filters do not change All runs, Session runs or logs. Copy a benchmark trace ID into **Trace ID** and reset session filters for correlated logs. Session name and ID are searchable Tempo dropdowns with literal matching; reset them to All. For rename history select the stable ID and set name to All. Names containing backticks are excluded; use their ID. Other filters are RE2 regexes: escape punctuation and use `.*` to reset. Select a trace ID for Tempo Explore / waterfall, or paste it in **Trace ID** to filter logs below without Explore. Expand a log row for structured metadata and its trace link. Explore and import require appropriate Grafana permissions; API read access does not grant them.

panels.title: All runs · legacy / unsaved fallback (no session filters)
Session runs · filtered ID / name
panels.description: Rows are traces containing matching run spans, not one row per child run. Missing names are included when Session name is All. Use stable ID with name All to include pre-rename traces. Session ID must be present.

panels.title: Benchmark runs · comparison / task / replicate
panels.description: Optional resource filters apply only here, independently of session filters. Defaults include absent benchmark fields. Trace-level navigation, not paired scoring or process wall/CPU/RSS measurement.
